speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
title: The Ninety and Ten
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Michael A. Dunn spoke about “The Ninety and Ten”.

quotes.text: Among the myriad nearly incomprehensible blessings of our Savior Jesus Christ is His promise to carry our burdens. But what does that look like in practical terms—especially when we are weighed down and seemingly without hope?
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Everything about it seemed impossible—except for one thing, and that was that Ted believed I could do it. That mattered because he had completed the race himself many times. He knew every twist of the trail and promised that if I would put in the training, he would be there to run with me through the second half of the race when fatigue, blisters, and especially self-doubt would become my worst enemies.
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: With Ted’s patience and persistence and my unceasing silent prayers, we miraculously ran—make that trudged—to mile 90. Morning had barely dawned. Just 10 miles remained. But I was completely sapped—running on empty, as it were. Collapsing in the shade of a tree, I looked over at Ted and quietly said, “I give up.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Those simple, sincere words sparked something inside me. After a few more minutes, I got to my feet. At first I walked, then hobbled into, well, a pretty solid shuffle. And somehow, step by step, together we conquered those last 10 miles.
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: A week or so later, a photograph from the race arrived in the mail. Miraculously, a friend captured that exact moment when Ted and I parted ways. But it also revealed a startling secret.
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As I marveled at his benevolence, my thoughts immediately turned to an infinitely more amazing load-bearing Friend, our Savior Jesus Christ, who, as Isaiah unequivocally assured, has “borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows,” which I assumed meant the trails we travel would somehow become easier. But as I’ve come to learn through this race and the ups and downs of my life, He simultaneously lifts and uplifts, sometimes in unseen fashion, multiplying and magnifying even our most minuscule offerings. In other words, the Redeemer rescues not by shortening our course but by helping us lengthen our stride.
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Anytime we turn to Christ, we turn a corner. By His grace we can trust and expect His constant care. And because God knows our prayers even before we ask Him, it’s reasonable to assume that blessings may often materialize in the selfsame moment we verbalize. His grace, which is a duality defined as a “divine means of help or strength,” can free us from the freight we would otherwise carry. And even when we don’t perceive Him at our side, He enlists the Teds—both of this world and sometimes even the Teds beyond—with His heartening promise of angels all around us to bear us up.
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: To those at or nearing their “mile 90,” ferrying the unimaginable, or if you feel like I did, both depleted and defeated, I promise that as you expend even your last drops of energy to ask, His helping hand will ultimately give you that much-needed leg up. And even when the outcome or the timing is not what you plead for, take solace knowing that feeling broken does not mean you’ve been abandoned by God.
quotes.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
